prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1257; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured regarding a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured reports the other vehicle backed into the driver's side door while exiting a space. Police report not filed as damage was minor. Photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Photos received and reviewed. Visible damage to left rear quarter panel and door of insured vehicle consistent with the reported incident. Liability appears to lie with the other driver. Contacted the other party's carrier to open a liability file.

Entry 3: Claimant reports a knee injury sustained during the collision and has retained counsel. All further communication to be directed through the claimant's attorney. Medical records and bills requested through counsel. Reserve set pending receipt of treatment documentation.

Entry 4: Counsel's office confirmed representation in writing and provided a preliminary treatment summary. Claimant is undergoing orthopedic evaluation for the knee. Diagnostic imaging ordered by treating provider. Will hold settlement discussions until treatment status is clearer.

Entry 5: Received updated treatment records and itemized medical bills from counsel. Injury claim is being evaluated alongside the vehicle damage estimate. Scheduled follow-up with counsel to discuss demand package and review liability position before making any offer.
